kmlib.compatibility_lost_lunalib_settings: KMLib's own settings will not take effect this session - the library logs at its default verbosity whatever the settings screen shows.
kmlib.compatibility_unaffected_lunalib_setting: On any other mod's settings, and on your save.
kmlib.compatibility_lost_nexerelin_routines: Colonies founded or handed over through KM mods will follow the game's own rules this session rather than Nexerelin's.
kmlib.compatibility_unaffected_nexerelin_routi: On Nexerelin's own colonisation and diplomacy, and on your save.
kmlib.compatibility_lost_rat_access_routes: Star systems reachable only through Random Assortment of Things' own routes will be read as cut off by KM mods this session.
kmlib.compatibility_unaffected_rat_access_rout: On those routes themselves, which still carry a fleet in play, and on your save.
